reason: At $1,500 a plan across a library of 50+ plans that's $75k+ I'd have to justify to the boss, and our margins on spec homes are thin. A walkthrough on the website is nice but I can't point to a sale it would close.
objection: $1,500 a home doesn't pencil on our margins, and I have no proof walkthroughs sell more homes than the renderings and floor plans we already post.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk library price around $150-300 a plan, or a pilot of a few plans with proof of more leads, plus a quote I can take to the boss.
